free_tier.stated: Endless FREE plan, no credit card required: single project, unlimited clients, up to 10 feature toggles per project, up to 2 environments per project, 2 seats included, data residency, user segmentation, session stickiness, realtime notifications, unlimited MAU, RBAC, embedded analytics, client SDKs, webhooks, admin API, Google and GitHub SSO and 2FA
free_tier.notes: The FREE plan is described as an endless free plan with the complete feature set. The next plan, PRO, is USD 49 a month for 3 projects, 10 seats and unlimited toggles per project. MAUs are unlimited on every plan.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-toggle value size cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period for toggles, audit logs or analytics is stated on the first-party pages read

egress.terms: not applicable: a flag service with unlimited clients and MAUs and no traffic allowance or byte price published

interface_detail: A JavaScript client SDK connects to a regional platform URL selected by account region (us-east-1, eu-central-1, ap-south-1) with a client key created in the project; it stores toggles in localStorage, synchronizes in the background at a configurable refresh interval and can bootstrap from local data. The site lists an admin API, generic webhooks and compatibility with other vendors' APIs.
tooling: The Toggled JavaScript client SDK and regional platform URLs; the site states compatibility with many client SDKs and provides Slack and MS Teams integrations.
chaining: Serve toggles to a single app from one project across up to two environments, using unlimited clients and MAUs and reading configuration through the regional client API.

limits.value: single project and up to 10 feature toggles per project on FREE
up to 2 environments per project and 2 seats included on FREE
unlimited clients and unlimited monthly active users on FREE

limits_note: Unlimited clients and MAUs; the binding thresholds are workspace size (one project, 10 toggles, 2 environments, 2 seats). Enforcement behaviour past these limits is not stated on the pricing page: subscribe to PRO to increase service quotas.
binding_note: The single project, 10-toggle and 2-seat ceilings bind first for a growing app; clients and MAUs are unlimited, so user growth does not consume a plan allowance.

identity_cost.detail: The regional sign-up form asks for Full name, Email address and Company, with a checkbox accepting the Terms and Privacy Policy; SSO through Google and GitHub is offered on the sign-in page. No card is required for the free plan. No phone number or ID is requested on the form; whether a later step asks for one is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The plan is described as endless and free with no card; the page says to subscribe to PRO to increase service quotas but does not state what happens past the free ceilings. Data residency is offered through independent regions in North America, Europe and APAC. A system status page, an admin API and helpdesk are listed.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from first-party pages: the pricing and plan content in the raw homepage fetch, the regional sign-up and sign-in pages, and the client SDK repository. No account was opened and no live toggle read was probed, so the record stays at documented rung. The plan wording was verified in the raw page fetch.
